title: Verified Landlord Trust Badge Rendering
description: A listing owned by a landlord whose identity has been verified must display the verified trust badge on its detail page, so students can distinguish vetted landlords from unvetted ones.
preconditions: Demo data loaded. 'Emerald House Hatfield' belongs to the verified demo landlord.
steps: Open properties.php as an anonymous visitor.
Open the listing 'Emerald House Hatfield' from the results grid.
Inspect the landlord information panel.
expected_result: The .badge-verified element is visible and reads 'Verified landlord'. The badge is absent for listings whose landlord has a null verified_at.

title: NSFAS Accreditation Badge Visibility
description: The NSFAS accreditation badge must appear on accredited listings only. A false positive here would mislead a funded student into applying for accommodation their bursary will not cover.
preconditions: Demo data loaded. Three of four seeded listings are NSFAS accredited; 'Durban North Student Lofts' is not.
steps: Open the detail page for 'Emerald House Hatfield' (accredited).
Confirm the NSFAS badge is present.
Open the detail page for 'Durban North Student Lofts' (not accredited).
Confirm the NSFAS badge is absent.
expected_result: The NSFAS badge renders for accredited listings and does not render for non-accredited listings.

title: Booking Call-to-Action Reflects Booking Mode
description: The primary button on a listing must read 'Instant Book' for instant-book properties and 'Request booking' for request-flow properties, so a student knows before clicking whether confirmation is immediate.
preconditions: Demo data loaded. Two seeded listings are instant-book, two are request-flow.
steps: Open the detail page for an instant-book listing and read the primary button label.
Open the detail page for a request-flow listing and read the primary button label.
Confirm the sandbox payment disclaimer is shown on both.
expected_result: Labels are 'Instant Book' and 'Request booking' respectively. Both pages display the 'No real payment is taken' disclaimer.

title: Search Grid Mobile Responsiveness
description: On a phone-sized viewport the property grid must collapse to a single column, the page must not scroll horizontally, and the navigation toggle must remain operable.
preconditions: Demo data loaded.
steps: Set the browser viewport to 375 x 812 (iPhone size).
Open properties.php.
Compare the bounding boxes of the first two property cards.
Compare document scroll width against viewport width.
Open the mobile navigation toggle.
expected_result: Cards are vertically stacked at the same x-offset. Document scroll width does not exceed viewport width. The navigation toggle is visible, has an accessible name, and reveals the menu when activated.

title: Role-Aware Header Navigation
description: The site header must reflect authentication state and role: signed-out visitors see sign-in and register links; signed-in users see dashboard and sign-out; the Reports link is visible to administrators only.
preconditions: Demo accounts exist for all three roles.
steps: Open the site while signed out and inspect the header.
Sign in as the demo student and inspect the header.
Confirm the Reports link is not present.
Sign out, sign in as the administrator, and confirm the Reports link is present.
expected_result: Header links match the current role in all three states. Reports appears for the administrator only.

title: Accessible Empty State and Status Messaging
description: A search returning no results must show guidance rather than a blank page, flash messages must be announced to screen readers, and property images must carry descriptive alternative text.
preconditions: Demo data loaded.
steps: Search for a term that matches no listing.
Confirm the empty state renders with guidance copy.
Sign in and inspect the welcome flash message for role='status'.
Inspect the alt attribute of each property card image.
expected_result: The empty state is visible with helpful copy. The flash element carries role='status'. Every property image has a non-empty alt attribute that is not merely the filename.

title: Register New Student Account
description: A prospective student must be able to create an account with valid details and be signed in and routed to the student dashboard on success.
preconditions: The email address used is not already registered.
steps: Open register.php.
Select the Student role and confirm the student number field becomes required.
Complete all required fields with valid data and accept the terms.
Submit the form.
expected_result: The account is created, the user is signed in, and the browser lands on dashboard.php with a success message. The user row exists with role 'student'.

title: Enforce Password Policy on Registration
description: Registration must reject passwords that fail the strength policy, and must not create a partial account when it does so.
preconditions: None.
steps: Open register.php and select the Student role.
Complete the form using a weak password such as 'pass'.
Submit the form.
Query the users table for the submitted email address.
expected_result: The form is redisplayed with a password policy error, the user remains on register.php, and no user row was created.

title: Reject Duplicate Email Registration
description: An email address already in use must not be able to register a second account, preventing account collision and confused sign-in.
preconditions: The demo student account exists.
steps: Open register.php.
Complete the form using the existing demo student email address.
Submit the form.
expected_result: Registration is refused with a clear message and no duplicate user row is created.

title: Reject Invalid Login Credentials
description: Sign-in must fail for a wrong password, an unknown email address, and empty input, and the error message must not reveal which of the two fields was wrong.
preconditions: The demo student account exists.
steps: Open login.php.
Submit a valid email with an incorrect password.
Submit an unregistered email address.
Confirm the error wording is identical in both cases.
expected_result: Both attempts are refused and remain on login.php. The message is generic (it does not distinguish 'no such user' from 'wrong password'), preventing account enumeration.

title: Throttle Repeated Failed Login Attempts
description: Repeated failed sign-in attempts must be rate limited, so that credential-stuffing and brute-force attacks are not viable against the login form.
preconditions: No recent failed attempts recorded for the test client.
steps: Open login.php.
Submit incorrect credentials five times in succession.
Submit a sixth attempt and observe the response.
expected_result: The sixth attempt is refused with HTTP 429 and a throttling message rather than a normal credential error.

title: Reject Form Submission Without CSRF Token
description: State-changing POST requests must carry a valid CSRF token, so a third-party site cannot submit actions on a signed-in user's behalf.
preconditions: None.
steps: Open login.php.
Remove the hidden CSRF token field from the form via the DOM.
Submit the form with otherwise valid credentials.
Observe the HTTP response status.
expected_result: The request is refused with HTTP 419 and the user is not signed in.

title: Student Logout and Session Termination
description: Signing out must destroy the session so that protected pages are no longer reachable, including via the browser back button or a direct URL.
preconditions: Signed in as the demo student.
steps: Sign in as the demo student and confirm dashboard.php loads.
Sign out using the header link.
Navigate directly to dashboard.php.
Confirm the session cookie value has changed or been cleared.
expected_result: After sign-out the user is returned to a public page, dashboard.php redirects to login.php, and the previous session identifier is no longer valid.

title: Block Unauthorised URL Access by Role
description: Typing another role's URL directly must be refused. A student must not reach the administrator or landlord dashboards, an anonymous visitor must not reach any dashboard, and no user may act on another user's booking.
preconditions: Demo accounts for all three roles exist.
steps: Signed in as a student, navigate directly to admin.php and to landlord.php.
Sign out and navigate directly to dashboard.php.
Signed in as a landlord, attempt to submit a booking.
Signed in as one student, attempt to simulate a deposit on another user's booking.
expected_result: Cross-role dashboard access returns HTTP 403. Anonymous access redirects to login.php. The landlord booking attempt is forbidden. The foreign booking action returns HTTP 404 rather than confirming the booking exists.

title: Filter Properties by NSFAS Status
description: The NSFAS filter must return exactly the accredited listings, and must combine correctly with other filters rather than replacing them.
preconditions: Demo data loaded: 4 published listings, 3 NSFAS accredited, 2 instant-book.
steps: Open properties.php and note the unfiltered result count.
Apply the NSFAS filter and count the results.
Confirm the non-accredited listing is absent.
Apply the NSFAS and Instant Book filters together.
expected_result: Unfiltered returns 4. NSFAS alone returns 3, excluding 'Durban North Student Lofts'. The combined filter returns the intersection, not the union.

title: Filter Properties by Maximum Rent
description: The maximum rent filter must exclude every listing priced above the cap, and the boundary value itself must be included.
preconditions: Demo data loaded, with rents of R4 550, R4 800, R5 200 and R6 100.
steps: Open properties.php.
Set the maximum rent filter to 5000 and apply it.
Read the rent shown on each returned card.
Clear the filters and confirm all listings return.
expected_result: Two listings are returned, both priced at or below R5 000. No returned rent exceeds the cap. Clearing filters restores all four.

title: Keyword Search and Empty Result Handling
description: Keyword search must match on city, suburb and institution, and a search with no matches must return a guided empty state rather than an error or a blank grid.
preconditions: Demo data loaded.
steps: Search for a city name and confirm the matching listing is returned.
Search for a nearby institution and confirm the matching listing is returned.
Search for a nonsense term with no matches.
Observe the response.
expected_result: Relevant listings are returned for valid terms. The nonsense search returns zero cards, an empty state with guidance copy, and HTTP 200 — not a server error.

title: Reject Invalid Booking Submission
description: The booking form must reject a move-in date in the past, an over-long message, and a reference to a property that does not exist, without creating a booking row in any case.
preconditions: Signed in as the demo student.
steps: Open the booking form for a valid listing.
Submit with a move-in date in the past.
Submit with a message exceeding the permitted length.
Request the booking form for a property id that does not exist.
expected_result: The first two submissions are refused with validation errors and remain on the booking form. The unknown property returns HTTP 404. No bookings row is created by any of the three.

title: Reject Malicious File Uploads
description: The NSFAS document upload must reject executable content disguised with an image or document file name, judging the file on its contents rather than its extension.
preconditions: Signed in as the demo student.
steps: Open the student dashboard document upload control.
Upload a file containing PHP source but named with a .png extension and an image MIME type.
Observe the response and check the uploads directory.
Upload a genuine PDF and confirm it is accepted.
expected_result: The disguised file is rejected with an error and no user_documents row or stored file is created. The genuine PDF is accepted and recorded with status 'pending'.

title: Search Grid Matches Database Contents
description: The listings shown on the search page must correspond exactly to the published rows in the properties table — no stale cache, no unpublished listing leaking through.
preconditions: Demo data loaded.
steps: Query the properties table directly for published rows.
Open properties.php and read the rendered card titles.
Compare the two sets.
Set one property's status to draft, reload, and compare again.
expected_result: The rendered set matches the queried set exactly on the first comparison. After the status change the drafted listing disappears from the grid and the count decreases by one.

title: Registration Stores Hashed Password and Correct Role
description: A successful registration must persist the correct role and must never store the password in plain text.
preconditions: None.
steps: Register a new student account through the web form.
Query the users table for the created row.
Inspect the password_hash column.
Inspect the role and status columns.
expected_result: The row exists with role 'student' and status 'active'. The password_hash column does not contain the submitted password and matches a bcrypt or Argon hash prefix.

title: Instant Booking Persists Booking and Escrow Records
description: Completing an instant booking must write a booking row in the approved state and a matching escrow row in the unpaid state, with the amount taken from the property, not the request.
preconditions: Signed in as the demo student. An instant-book listing exists.
steps: Submit an instant booking through the web form.
Query the bookings table for the newest row for that student.
Query the escrow_transactions table for the matching booking id.
Compare the escrow amount against the property's deposit amount.
expected_result: One booking row exists with status 'approved' and the correct property and student ids. One escrow row exists with status 'not_paid' and an amount equal to the property's stored deposit.

title: Escrow Simulation Transitions Through Every State
description: The simulated deposit must move through its states in order — not paid, held, released — and each transition must be reflected in both the database and the dashboard.
preconditions: An approved booking exists for the demo student.
steps: Confirm the escrow row starts at status 'not_paid'.
Trigger the deposit simulation from the dashboard and re-query.
Confirm the dashboard reports the deposit as securely held.
Confirm check-in and re-query.
Confirm a payment reference is displayed.
expected_result: Escrow status progresses not_paid to held to released. The booking reaches status 'completed'. A simulated payment reference beginning 'SIM-' is displayed and no real payment gateway is contacted.

title: Document Upload and Audit Log Persistence
description: An uploaded document must be stored under a randomised filename while retaining its original name for display, and every administrator verification action must be written to the audit log.
preconditions: Signed in as the demo student, then as the administrator.
steps: Upload a valid PDF from the student dashboard.
Query user_documents and compare the stored path against the original filename.
Sign in as the administrator and verify a landlord.
Query the audit_logs table for the newest entry.
expected_result: The stored filename differs from the original and is not guessable; the original name is retained in its own column. The audit log contains an 'admin.user_verified' entry naming the acting administrator and the affected user.

title: Complete Instant Book and Simulated Payment Journey
description: A student searches for accommodation, filters to instant-book listings, books one, simulates the deposit hold, confirms check-in, and sees the completed booking with a payment reference — the full happy path in one continuous session.
preconditions: Demo data loaded. Signed out at the start.
steps: Sign in as the demo student.
Search and filter the listings to instant-book only.
Open a listing from the grid and start the instant booking.
Submit the booking and confirm it is approved on the dashboard.
Simulate the deposit hold.
Confirm check-in and read the payment reference.
expected_result: The booking is approved immediately, the deposit moves to held then released, the booking reaches 'completed', and a simulated reference is displayed. The escrow row in the database agrees with the screen at every step.

title: Accommodation Request, Landlord Decision and Deposit Journey
description: A student submits a booking request on a non-instant listing, the landlord approves or declines it in a separate session, and the outcome is reflected back to the student — including the fact that a declined request offers no payment action.
preconditions: Demo data loaded. A request-flow listing exists.
steps: As the student, submit a booking request with a message.
Confirm the dashboard shows 'Awaiting landlord' and a response deadline.
Sign out and sign in as the landlord.
Approve the request and confirm the success message.
Sign back in as the student and simulate the deposit.
Repeat the flow with a declined request and inspect the available actions.
expected_result: The request starts pending with a 12-hour response deadline. On approval the student sees 'Approved' and the deposit action unlocks; the escrow row reaches 'held'. On decline the booking shows 'Declined', no action buttons are offered, and the escrow row remains 'not_paid'.

title: Landlord Verification and Document Review Journey
description: A new landlord registers and is unverified; an administrator verifies them and reviews a student's NSFAS document; both outcomes become visible to the affected users and are recorded in the audit trail.
preconditions: Demo data loaded.
steps: Register a new landlord from the 'List a property' call to action.
Confirm the dashboard reports verification as pending.
Sign in as the administrator and verify the new landlord.
Approve a student's uploaded NSFAS document.
Confirm both actions appear in the audit trail.
Sign in as each affected user and confirm the outcome is visible.
expected_result: The landlord dashboard changes from 'Verification pending' to 'Identity verified'. The student sees the document marked 'Approved'. Both actions are listed in the administrator's audit trail.

title: Security Headers and Session Cookie Hardening
description: Baseline protections must not regress: security response headers must be present on every response, and the session cookie must remain inaccessible to page scripts.
preconditions: None.
steps: Request any page and inspect the response headers.
Confirm X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Content-Security-Policy and Referrer-Policy are present and correctly valued.
Sign in and inspect the session cookie attributes.
Read document.cookie from page script and confirm the session cookie is absent.
expected_result: X-Frame-Options is DENY, X-Content-Type-Options is nosniff, the CSP includes frame-ancestors 'none', and Referrer-Policy is set. The session cookie is HttpOnly with SameSite=Lax and is not readable from JavaScript.

title: Output Escaping and Currency Formatting
description: Database-sourced content must be HTML-escaped on render so that stored markup cannot execute, and all monetary values must render in South African Rand format.
preconditions: Demo data loaded. Test restores any modified data afterwards.
steps: Store a property title containing an HTML injection payload.
Open that property's detail page.
Confirm the payload did not execute and is displayed as literal text.
Restore the original title.
Read every price on the search grid and check its format.
expected_result: The injected script does not execute and the title renders as literal text. Every price matches the pattern 'R' followed by space-separated thousands, for example 'R 5 200'.

title: Prevent Price Tampering via Request Parameters
description: Monetary values must be read from the database on the server, never from the request. A tampered deposit or rent field submitted with a booking must be ignored.
preconditions: Signed in as the demo student. An instant-book listing with a known deposit amount exists.
steps: Open the booking form for a listing whose deposit amount is known.
Inject additional monthly_rent and deposit_amount fields into the form with altered values.
Submit the booking.
Query the escrow_transactions row created by the submission.
Compare its amount against the property's stored deposit amount.
expected_result: The escrow amount equals the property's stored deposit amount, not the value supplied in the request. The tampered fields have no effect on any persisted value.

title: Resist SQL Injection on Public Inputs
description: Every input that reaches a database query must be parameterised. Tautology and stacked-statement payloads submitted through the search field and the sign-in form must be treated as ordinary text.
preconditions: Demo data loaded.
steps: Submit the payload ' OR '1'='1 through the property search field.
Confirm the response is HTTP 200 with no database error text.
Confirm the search returns zero results rather than every listing.
Submit a stacked DROP TABLE payload and confirm the users table still exists.
Submit tautology payloads through the sign-in email and password fields.
expected_result: All payloads are treated as literal search or credential text. No SQLSTATE, syntax error or fatal error appears in any response. A tautology does not act as a wildcard and does not authenticate. The database schema is unchanged.

title: Prevent Account Enumeration and Credential Disclosure
description: The application must not reveal which email addresses are registered, and must never write a submitted password back into a rendered page where it would reach browser cache, history or proxy logs.
preconditions: The demo student account exists.
steps: Attempt sign-in with a registered email and an incorrect password; record the message.
Attempt sign-in with an unregistered email; record the message.
Compare the two messages.
Submit a registration that will fail, using a distinctive password.
Search the returned page source for that password.
expected_result: Both sign-in failures produce an identical message. The rejected registration page source does not contain the submitted password anywhere.

title: Enforce Access Control on Documents and Bookings
description: Authorisation must be checked on the server for every object, not inferred from an unguessable URL. Uploaded identity documents must require a session, the uploads directory must not be browsable, and no user may act on another user's booking.
preconditions: A student has uploaded a document and holds a booking.
steps: Upload a document as the demo student and read its stored filename from the database.
Clear all cookies and request that file directly by URL.
Request the uploads directory itself and inspect the response.
Register a second student and POST a deposit action naming the first student's booking id.
Re-query the first student's escrow row.
expected_result: The anonymous document request is refused. The uploads directory returns 403 or 404, never an index listing. The cross-account booking action returns HTTP 404 without confirming the booking exists, and the victim's escrow row is unchanged.

title: Harden File Upload Handling
description: Uploads must be judged on their contents, and a client-supplied filename must never influence the write location. On a PHP host an executable upload is remote code execution.
preconditions: Signed in as the demo student.
steps: Upload a valid PDF whose filename contains directory traversal sequences.
Read the stored_name and original_name columns for that upload.
Upload a file containing PHP source but declaring a PDF MIME type.
Confirm the response and check whether a row was created.
expected_result: The stored name is 40 random hex characters plus an extension derived from the sniffed MIME type, containing no traversal sequences or path separators. The disguised PHP file is rejected with a type error and no row is created.

title: Protect Session Transport and Prevent Caching
description: The session identifier must never travel in a URL, and authenticated pages must not be storable by a browser or shared cache — otherwise a back-button press on a shared computer redisplays the previous user's dashboard.
preconditions: Signed in as the demo student.
steps: Record every request URL issued during a signed-in browsing session.
Search those URLs for a session identifier parameter.
Request the student dashboard and inspect its Cache-Control header.
expected_result: No request URL contains a session identifier. The dashboard sends a Cache-Control header including no-store or no-cache.

title: Suppress Internal Detail in Error Responses
description: Error responses must not disclose server file paths, stack traces, SQL fragments or PHP diagnostics, which together reveal the directory layout and framework versions to an attacker.
preconditions: None.
steps: Request a property detail page for an id that does not exist.
Request a property detail page with a non-numeric id.
Request a booking page with a negative property id.
Request a page that does not exist.
Inspect each response body for internal detail.
expected_result: No response contains a server file path, 'Stack trace', 'SQLSTATE', or a PHP Warning, Notice or Deprecated message. Failures are handled with clean status codes and user-facing copy.
